name: Weekly bookings report explainer
purpose: Turns the weekly bookings CSV into a short Monday report in plain language: revenue, cancellations, channels, data problems and questions, with every number traceable to rows.

inputs.name: last_week
inputs.label: Last week (optional)
inputs.hint: Last week's confirmed revenue and booking count, if you have them.

inputs.name: csv
inputs.label: Bookings CSV
inputs.hint: Paste the Weekly bookings export, header row included. Remove client name and email columns first.

output.description: Markdown with five headings: Headline, Data issues, What changed, Watch list, Questions for Monday. 250 words or fewer.

do: Remove client name and email columns before pasting.
Paste the full export with its header row.
Give last week's figures if you want a comparison.
dont: Do not read a possible reason as a proven cause.
Do not paste a partial export and expect a weekly total.
Do not use the report to judge individual staff.

modelSettings.notes: Low temperature for steady arithmetic. Turn code interpreter on where it is offered so sums are calculated, not estimated; always spot-check the headline figure against the CSV.

paste.chatgpt: Explore GPTs, Create, Configure tab. Paste the Instructions block into Instructions, upload the three knowledge files under Knowledge, switch Code interpreter on and Web search off.
paste.claude: Projects, Create project. Paste instructions.md into Set project instructions and add the three knowledge files under Project knowledge. Turn on the analysis tool if your plan offers it.

examples.title: A clean week with a target miss and one very large booking
